title: Deceptive-Reasoning Taxonomy Tagger for Thinking Traces

original_idea.body: # Deceptive-Reasoning Taxonomy Tagger for Thinking Traces. Build an LLM-judge tagger with a fixed deceptive-reasoning rubric over CoT traces, validate against human labels, report category frequencies and difficulty correlation.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Shared deceptive-reasoning taxonomy/tagger supports CoT monitoring, an RFP-flagged pathway.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: LLM-judge tagger over existing transcripts + human-label validation; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused tagger + frequency report; taxonomy design + validation is moderate effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Reusable monitoring infrastructure over public transcripts; labs underweight.

novelty.reasoning: Taxonomy work exists but no compact open tagger; partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Taxonomy work exists; compact open tagger + difficulty correlation plausibly open.
